renderer: headless Chromium software rendering; not a phone/GPU performance claim
correctionHistory: Initial walking assertion wrongly treated the final approach half-step and surface sliding as penetration; changed to measure the solid boundary and actual constrained movement.

Initial boat assertion wrongly required the first high-speed contact position to stay fixed while throttle continued; changed to assert the oriented footprint remains outside each actual rock and settles at the valid boundary.

The main contact assertion also incorrectly required a movement-only blockedBy hint after releasing the throttle. The final independent live driving run sampled valid occupied-space boundaries during continuous throttle, verified release to zero speed, and verified the new rejection of turn-into-rock while preserving look offset. Raw main runs remain archived as case-09-v12-first/second/third-verification.json.
